'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 2 Brad Eier LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Brad Erer
* '''Deck name:''' WTFPWNT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
